Unmodified copy of the existing photo-prep tool supplied for this Director route.
Source files: prep_photo, prep_photo.py, README.md.
They are not a new image pipeline. Model weights are not included.
The box copy remains the runtime command when DIRECTOR_PREP_PHOTO points at it.
